failure_modes.name: Multi_Hop_Context_Degradation
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 states 'Passage [1] confirms that Defari was part of the Likwit Crew' and identifies three missing evidence items including 'Documentation of which Likwit Crew member hosted an MTV show'. However, Summary_2 claims 'No passage about Defari or the Likwit Crew - The claim requires confirmation of which band Defari was part of, but no passage identifies Defari or provides information about his musical group affiliation', contradicting the earlier finding and losing track of the Likwit Crew connection established in hop 1.

failure_modes.name: Evidence_Present_But_Missed
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_2 claims 'No passage about Defari or the Likwit Crew' and 'no passage identifies Defari or provides information about his musical group affiliation'. However, passage [1] from hop 1 explicitly states: 'Street Music is the third album by Defari, an American hip hop musician who is also part of the Likwit Crew.' This passage was available to the solver and directly identifies both Defari and his band affiliation.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query for hop 2: 'Which MTV show was hosted by a member of the Likwit Crew, and did they host a show called "You Can't See Me"?' This is a compound multi-part yes/no question bundling two distinct retrieval targets rather than a focused query targeting a single entity or fact.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query for hop 3: 'Did a member of the Likwit Crew host an MTV show called "You Can't See Me"?' This is formulated as a yes/no question rather than a query targeting specific entities or documents.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Query hop 2: 'Which MTV show was hosted by a member of the Likwit Crew, and did they host a show called "You Can't See Me"?' and Query hop 3: 'Did a member of the Likwit Crew host an MTV show called "You Can't See Me"?' Both queries ask essentially the same question about Likwit Crew members hosting 'You Can't See Me', with only minor rewording. Neither query pivots to search for individual Likwit Crew members (Evidence, J-Ro, E-Swift, The Alchemist, DJ Babu) mentioned in hop 1.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 explicitly names the missing entity: 'Verification that an MTV show called "You Can't See Me" exists'. Query hop 2 targets this: 'did they host a show called "You Can't See Me"?' and query hop 3 continues: 'Did a member of the Likwit Crew host an MTV show called "You Can't See Me"?' Despite two well-formed queries attempting to retrieve information about the show 'You Can't See Me', no passage about this MTV show was ever returned across all three hops, indicating a corpus gap.
